sources.description: The 2026 NFL regular season schedule will be officially announced tonight at 8:00 pm Eastern. Both NFL Network and ESPN will be covering the schedule release. Of course we already know the 17 Jets opponents for the upcoming season. We also know whether these will be home or road games. All we really are discovering […]
